reviews.text: Ron came out right away when my pool pump went out. He evaluated my system and talked through options. The work was completed in great time and better cost than I was expecting. Fantastic service and I will certainly use Patriot Pools for future service.
reviews.author: David Child

reviews.text: Ron replaced my pump with a variable speed model. He was fast and efficient and spent the time with me to help set everything up.  As always, Ron gives 5 star service for an affordable price. Great job!  I highly recommend.
reviews.author: Brad Dill

reviews.text:
Ron,
I want thank you again for the outstanding job you recently did replacing our pool heater. The prompt response and assessment to what we needed to be done satisfy our home buyer was much appreciated. As a result we were able to stay on the closing schedule to get the sale completed.
As in the past I have always found  your pricing to be fair and service response to be excellent.

Bob C
reviews.author: Bob Carroll

reviews.text: Ron is always fair and does a great job. Nothing but good experience with him for several years. We highly recommend Ron for any pool work you might need.
reviews.author: Hilde Watkins

reviews.text: Ron with Patriot Pools was so helpful, knowledgeable and honest! We hired Ron to do a complete inspection and estimate of repairs on a fixer-up pool at a home we were thinking about buying. Ron is very knowledgeable. His inspection was so thorough that we knew exactly what we were walking into when we bought the house and were so impressed with Ron and his service that we ended up hiring him to do all the repairs and updates of our pool. He is quick to respond, reliable and his prices are super fair. He doesn’t price gouge! We are completely impressed and happy with Ron and his work at Patriot Pools!
reviews.author: Tiffany Ludwig

reviews.text: Ron has always been very responsive when I have.needed pool work. He is very knowledgeable about pool equipment and knows how to fix and service everything from the smallest to the largest jobs. His prices are reasonable and the work is finished quickly and on time. I would recommend him to anyone for all pool services.
reviews.author: Roger Pitkin

reviews.text: Highly recommend Patriot Pool Service! My bosses pool lights stopped working a few months ago. Ron came over and checked things out the day after I gave him a call. He was quick, professional, and very honest. He also installed a pool heater for us as well. We have a lit pool and a hot tub that stays heated. Thank you Ron!
reviews.author: Kinslee Hansen

reviews.text: Our water feature pump died days before the first freeze of the season. I called Patriot Pool Service on a Saturday looking for someone who could come look at the pump to decide if it could be repaired or needed a full replace. Ron was extremely helpful over the phone and was able to come on Sunday (before the predicted freeze) to take a look. He diagnosed the issue immediately, was able to supply multiple options for us to consider, and even fixed a gasket leak at no charge on the spot! It is evident that Ron is very knowledgeable about pools and pool equipment/systems. We are very satisfied with the work done and will call Patriot Pool Service for future repairs.
reviews.author: Pamela Williams
